fields.label: Use Case
fields.description: Which use case made this request.
The person who made the request — not the account Crema acted as.
fields.label: User
Status
fields.description: Success — answered by the AI. Cached — answered from a saved earlier reply, at no cost. Blocked — stopped by a safety check or a spending limit. Error — the request failed.
Why it was blocked, or what went wrong. Never contains the text that was sent.
fields.label: Detail
Total Tokens
fields.description: How much text was handled, counted the way AI services bill it.
What this request cost. 0 if the price of this model is not known.
fields.label: Cost (USD)

fields.description: The internal name of the use case. Reports and spending limits group on this, so it stays as it is even when the label changes.
fields.label: Use Case Key

fields.description: Which AI service answered. Kept as plain text, so deleting a service never removes its history.
fields.label: Provider

fields.description: A one-way fingerprint of the text sent, so identical requests can be matched up. The text itself is never stored.
fields.label: Prompt Fingerprint

fields.description: This row's position in the tamper-evidence chain — creation timestamps can tie, so this is what fixes the true order. Blank on a row written before this field existed.
fields.label: Chain Order

fields.description: A fingerprint of this row chained to the one before it, so an edited or deleted row becomes evident. Blank on a row written before this field existed.
fields.label: Chain Fingerprint

fields.description: How many calls to the AI service this entry was billed for. Usually 1 — an OCR request that needed a second, stronger attempt bills 2.
fields.label: Provider Calls
